scope: Skills move to .agents/skills (bead cr-e0a, unit U3 of plan B): the workshop's skill tree moves from .claude/skills to .agents/skills, with .claude/skills a directory link to it; readers of skill paths follow. Two hashed files change for the move: the implement playbook's review-package.sh and the migrate-claude-to-codex helper.

subject: doc:.claude/skills/mvp-mode/playbooks/implement.md
why: Bead cr-e0a, unit U3 (skills move to .agents/skills, .claude/skills a link). The playbook's review-package.sh maps a path given through the Claude view (bare, ./ or absolute) to two literal pathspecs, the canonical .agents/skills path and the Claude path, so a review package keeps a skill change across the move. Steps and traits unchanged.

subject: ours:migrate-claude-to-codex
why: Bead cr-e0a, unit U3. The helper decides per skill: no .codex/skills link for a Claude skill that is its .agents/skills counterpart (Codex reads that tree itself), a conflict warning when a same-name .agents/skills skill is independent, the legacy link otherwise; verify checks .agents/skills too; the discovery check accepts only skill paths under the target repository. The SKILL.md and mapping prose are unchanged (later content bead). No trait is added or removed. Tree hash refreshed.
